The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) reported that about 9,489 cubic meters of drainage and waterways in Metro Manila have been cleared through declogging and desilting operations.

These efforts are part of the “Oplan Kontra Baha” program, implemented following directives from President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to prevent flooding and ensure public safety, the DPWH said in a social media post on Saturday. https://t.co/8omV5g4T7G

“4 star PNPA General ngayon Lead Street Sweeper”

Ito ang  reaksiyon ng beteranong broadcaster na si Jay Sonza kaugnay ng pagkakatalaga kay dating PNP Chief Gen. Nicolas Torre III bilang general manager ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority.

Sa kanyang pahayag, tahasang binigyang-diin ni Sonza ang umano’y pagbaba ng posisyon ng isang dating 4-star PNPA general, na ayon sa kanya ay ginawang parang “chief traffic enforcer at lead street sweeper.” 

Iniuugnay rin niya ang appointment sa usapin ng pulitika at loyalty sa administrasyon.

“4-star PNPA general & persecutor ng KOJC@SMNI ginawang chief traffic enforcer at lead street sweeper.
BBM BRAND OF LOYALTY.”*

#marcos #VPSaraDuterte #Duterte #DavaoCity #AngBalitaNgayonFB
